changes.title: 归母利润、实付股息与现金回购（亿元）

query.sql: SELECT h.year::text AS year,x.item,x.amount FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id=h.company_id AND co.code='01698.HK' LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT max(d.value) FILTER (WHERE d.line_item='实付本公司股东现金股息') AS div, max(d.value) FILTER (WHERE d.line_item='现金回购支出') AS buyback FROM vi_disclosed d WHERE d.company_id=h.company_id AND d.period=h.year::text AND d.period_kind='全年') r ON true CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('归母净利润',h.np_parent),('实付现金股息',r.div),('现金回购',r.buyback)) x(item,amount) WHERE h.year>=2020 AND x.amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year,x.item
